propositions: Under rich_text_cutover='cloud', the outbound comment differ computes its two body-equality keys using different decode compositions (markdown round-trip on local side vs plain adf_to_text on Jira side), causing markdown comments to never match their own landed bodies despite being within length limits.

The local side applies AdfCodec.normalize_outbound (which escapes markdown-active characters and rewrites autolinks), while the Jira side uses adf_to_text (which does not escape), creating a key mismatch for identical comment content.

The send path encodes the decorated comment (with HTML comment marker), which causes markdown_to_adf to degrade the whole document to plain text encoding; the local key round-trips the undecorated body through rich codec, diverging from the landed wire.

The fix derives the local dedup key by predicting the exact as-sent wire (decorate → fit → encode) and decoding it with the same _normalize_comment_body decoder used for the Jira side, eliminating the asymmetry.

The defect was introduced by commit 27b868ba55 which moved the send path onto codec ADF encoding of the decorated body while leaving the Jira-side decode on normalize_rich_text, creating the asymmetric composition.

Verification across an 8-cell matrix (cutover off/cloud × in-limit markdown / over-length markdown / plain in-limit / oversize plain) confirms the new one-decoder approach produces matching keys in all cells while preserving prior matching behavior.
